Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor

A Day of Aloha and Remembrance: Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor

Experience the unique blend of festive cheer and solemn remembrance with this one-day agenda for observing Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor from the comfort of your home. Honor resilience with island traditions and delicious treats.

  1. Morning

    Prepare the Feast & Dress in Aloha

    Begin your day by preparing the main dishes for your luau and donning your most festive aloha prints to set the joyful island mood.

    Recipes: Kalua Pork (Hawaiian Slow-Roasted Pork) · Pineapple Haupia

  2. Late Afternoon

    Setting the Festive Glow

    As dusk approaches, light memorial lanterns and string lights around your space, echoing Honolulu's torchlit wreaths along the harbor.

  3. Early Evening

    A Pearl Harbor Luau Feast

    Gather for a heartwarming luau, savoring the rich flavors of the island feast in honor of resilience and community.

    Recipes: Kalua Pork (Hawaiian Slow-Roasted Pork)

  4. Evening

    Sweet Island Melodies

    Indulge in refreshing island desserts while playing gentle ukulele music, creating a serene atmosphere reminiscent of serenading veterans.

    Recipes: Pineapple Haupia · Shaved Ice with Festive Red and Green Syrups

  5. Late Evening

    Quiet Reflection and Remembrance

    Take a moment for quiet reflection, remembering the history and resilience, as families do during this significant time.

  6. Midnight

    Midnight Toast to Resilience

    Raise a glass of creamy coconut eggnog, offering a heartfelt toast to resilience and hope, mirroring the solemn midnight services.

    Recipes: Tiki Coconut Eggnog

May your day be filled with the spirit of aloha, remembrance, and the warmth of a Hawaiian Christmas.
